hero.description: From strategy to deployment — we partner with you to design, build, train, and scale AI solutions that deliver measurable results.

list.title: AI Services Across the Full Stack
list.subtitle: We cover every phase of the AI journey — from identifying opportunities to building and running production systems

items.title: AI Agent Development
items.tagline: Autonomous AI that works for you
items.description: We design and build intelligent agents that automate complex multi-step workflows, handle customer interactions, make data-driven decisions, and operate autonomously across your business systems.
benefits: Custom agents trained on your data and processes
Seamless integration with existing tools (CRM, ERP, etc.)

items.title: AI Workflow Automation
items.description: We map, redesign, and automate your manual workflows using AI — from data entry and document routing to approvals and reporting. Free your team to focus on high-value work.

items.title: AI API Development
items.tagline: Scalable AI infrastructure for your products
items.description: We build robust, production-ready AI APIs that integrate seamlessly into your existing systems and third-party applications — giving your products AI superpowers without the complexity.
benefits: RESTful and GraphQL API design and implementation
LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, local models)

items.title: Model Training & Fine-Tuning
items.description: Generic AI models often miss the nuance of your industry. We fine-tune and train models on your proprietary data to achieve superior accuracy, domain expertise, and business-specific performance.
benefits: On-premise or private cloud deployment options

items.title: AI Product Development
items.tagline: From idea to production-ready AI product
items.description: Full-cycle AI product development — we partner with you from ideation through UX design, engineering, testing, and production deployment to build AI-powered products your users will love.
benefits: AI product strategy and roadmap development
UX/UI design optimized for AI interactions

items.title: Consulting & Strategy
items.tagline: AI transformation with a clear roadmap
items.description: Not sure where to start with AI? Our experts help you identify the highest-value opportunities, build practical roadmaps, and guide your organization through a successful AI transformation journey.
benefits: AI readiness assessment and gap analysis
Use case identification and ROI modeling
